messages:
Elena (CSM): FYI - Aster Labs wants to move forward but procurement is asking for a short 9mo term, net60, and split invoicing across two cost centers. They also said e-sign can't proceed until DPA is confirmed. Can we align?
Raj (AE): Thanks Elena. They're asking for a 15% term discount for 9mo. I told them I'd check with CS/Billing/legal.
Priya (BillingOps): Net60 is okay but we need vendor tax ID and both cost center codes before creating split invoices. Can you ask them for: `tax_id`, `cc1`, `cc2`, and preferred PO number format?
Elena (CSM): I'll ping procurement now. @ProcurementSyncBot can you attach the latest SOW and the quote we have in CRM?
ProcurementSyncBot: Attached: quote_5178A_v3.pdf and SOW_aster_2025.pdf. (automated) :paperclip:
Aster Procurement (external): Hi Elena — tax_id is 84-1234567, cost centers are 4021 and 4022. PO will be generated after we have the exact invoice lines and net60 terms on the quote. Also legal needs DPA signed or at least in review before signature.
Dmitri (Legal): I can prioritize the DPA review but need to confirm subprocessor list and whether customer requires any redlines. Elena, do they want vendor-managed KMS or our hosted key option?
Elena (CSM): They prefer customer-managed KMS but said it's negotiable. They want the renewal to close by end of month if possible.
Raj (AE): On the 15% discount — we could do a one-time onboarding credit instead of permanent discount. That keeps list price intact for annual renewals. Thoughts?
Priya (BillingOps): One-time credit works for billing. If we do that, please confirm credit amount and describe it on the quote as: `One-time onboarding credit - applied to first invoice`. Also confirm how they'd like the credit allocated across the two cost centers.
Elena (CSM): I'll ask them to confirm allocation by EOD.
Dmitri (Legal): I'll run the DPA against our baseline and flag anything unusual. Estimated turnaround 48 hours if no substantive redlines. If they insist on KMS terms, that may add time.
Raj (AE): If timeline is tight, propose this compromise to the customer: sign SOW & PO with a conditional clause: "signature effective upon DPA execution within 30 days". That lets procurement get their PO out and us start onboarding prep.
Priya (BillingOps): We can accept a conditional signature clause but need the PO to explicitly reference the quote number and net60. Also give us a sample PO line to reduce back-and-forth. Example: 
```
PO: AST-2026-4567 | Quote: 5178A_v3 | CC1: 4021 $45,000 | CC2: 4022 $30,000 | Net: 60
```
Elena (CSM): Sending that sample now. Aster procurement — can you confirm PO will include that exact line format?
Aster Procurement (external): Confirmed. We'll draft PO with those lines. We still need the credit defined on the quote — prefer it on CC1.
Raj (AE): I'll create a revised quote with a `One-time onboarding credit - $7,500 applied to CC1` and term set to 9 months. Pushing it into CRM now.
ProcurementSyncBot: Updated quote 5178A_v4 generated and attached. (automated) :gear:
Priya (BillingOps): Received. Once DPA is in review we can accept conditional signature and schedule invoice issuance on PO receipt. Please also send legal contact for Aster so Dmitri can loop them in.
Elena (CSM): Aster legal contact is sara.k@asterlabs.com. Sara is leading the DPA review.
Dmitri (Legal): Thanks — looping in. I'll track DPA status here. If redlines look small we can keep timeline.
Elena (CSM): Action items: 1) Raj to finalize quote with one-time credit (in progress). 2) Aster to send PO with sample line (they confirmed). 3) Dmitri to review DPA (48h estimate). 4) Priya to prepare split invoice template once PO received. Target close: 2026-06-30.
Raj (AE): Agreed. I'll also draft the conditional-signature language for procurement to include.
Priya (BillingOps): Noted. I'll idle creating actual invoices until PO is uploaded to billing portal to avoid duplicate work.
Elena (CSM): Great team — I'll update the customer and post back here when PO lands. :thumbsup:
(2 hours later) ProcurementSyncBot: PO AST-PO-99876 uploaded to billing portal by Aster Procurement (external).
Elena (CSM): I see the PO in the portal. Priya, can you confirm next steps?
Priya (BillingOps): Confirmed. I'll queue the proforma split invoice and hold final e-sign until we get positive DPA status or Dmitri's greenlight.
Dmitri (Legal): DPA review complete — minor standard comments, no blocker. Approving conditional signature flow.
Elena (CSM): Perfect — proceeding to execute. Thanks everyone. :party:
